rationale: All 5 integration tests pass with 100% success. The security policy is cleanly implemented: private/project assistants are authenticated and authorized via Depends(authenticate) and Ability(user).can(Action.READ, assistant), while global assistants (is_global=True) are exempt and allow anonymous access. Standard Ruff formatting and license checks have completed with zero errors or warnings.

standards_review.notes: Commit subject follows the 'EPMCDME-####: Description' format precisely: EPMCDME-14367: Enforce authentication and authorization on A2A agent-card endpoint
All changed and new modules use async def, standard typing, and clean error handling via FastAPI and ExtendedHTTPException. Ruff linter and formatter checks pass perfectly.

Access permissions are correctly checked via Ability(user).can(Action.READ, assistant) before returning the agent card. Anonymous requests are blocked with 401, unauthorized users with 403. Global marketplace assistants (is_global=True) remain anonymously discoverable as intended.
